violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence
violation_type.typical_finding: During an inspection children were playing a video game that involved fighting. The caregiver was spoken to about the viceo's being educational and relating to their activty plan. The video game was turned off.

finding_variants.text: During an inspection children were playing a video game that involved fighting. The caregiver was spoken to about the viceo's being educational and relating to their activty plan. The video game was turned off.
At the time of the inspection, a classroom was seen playing the fortnite video This was brought into compliance when the caregiver turned the game off during the inspection.

At the time of the inspection, a child was watching an anime cartoon on Youtube on her laptop. Another child was watching cartoons on Youtube. It was observed that the anime cartoon showed characters fighting with weapons. Both children were shown advertisements on the shows they were viewing.

Gauntlet Legends is a video games that is present at the operation.  This video game includes violent game play.     This was corrected at inspection when the game was unplugged and no longer available to the children.
